new_photos.caption: Lamar Jackson’s return lasted one offensive snap before a right-thumb injury ended his afternoon.

new_photos.alt: Lamar Jackson lines up behind center Cam Jurgens against the Bills
new_photos.caption: Jackson lines up behind Cam Jurgens in Buffalo. Minter said afterward that Jackson needs thumb surgery and will go on injured reserve.

new_photos.alt: Joe Fagnano throws from the pocket against Buffalo
new_photos.caption: Fagnano made his NFL debut after Jackson and Tyler Huntley both left injured. He finished 10-of-21 for 91 yards.

new_photos.alt: Kyle Hamilton tackles a Bills ball carrier
new_photos.caption: Hamilton and the defense kept the Ravens close early, but Buffalo eventually pulled away.

new_photos.alt: Derrick Henry carries the ball against the Bills
new_photos.caption: Henry scored the Ravens’ only touchdown, a two-yard run after Broderick Washington’s interception.

reused_archival_photo.alt: Tyler Loop kicks with Ryan Eckley holding against Tennessee in Week 4
reused_archival_photo.caption: Loop kicking against Tennessee in Week 4. His range has produced memorable moments; the missed 34-yarder in Buffalo renewed concerns about consistency.
